name: dsh-bus
description: Cross-session message bus for local DSH sessions. Two lanes: chat (real-time, wakes the idle peer and budgets by real token spend) and digest (relay queue for weekly/monthly summaries). Tools: bus_send / bus_wait / bus_read / bus_peers / bus_budget. 支持已读回执、幂等发送、可配置额度与保留期。
